title: Bhagirath Homestays — Digital Growth Case Study | Studio 1947
description: How Studio 1947 transformed the digital presence of Bhagirath Homestays in Mirik, Darjeeling — driving 30+ room nights and ₹55K+ in revenue over seven months through OTA listings and data analytics.
ogDescription: Data-driven digitalization for a homestay in Mirik: 30+ room nights and ₹55K+ revenue in seven months.
html:

Bhagirath Homestays

Mirik, Darjeeling 2025 7-month engagement

The primary objective of this project was to implement digitalization strategies to fuel business growth for Bhagirath Homestay. Facilitated by Studio 1947, the initiative successfully generated more than 30 room nights and over ₹55,000 in room revenue across a seven-month period.

Introduction

Bhagirath Homestays, a serene retreat in the heart of Mirik, offers travelers an authentic and immersive experience. With its picturesque surroundings and warm hospitality, Bhagirath Homestays aims to provide a peaceful getaway for those seeking solace in nature.

The Objective

Bhagirath Homestays faced significant challenges in reaching a wider audience and maximizing occupancy. Studio 1947 was tasked with transforming the homestay's digital presence to boost visibility, drive bookings, and ensure sustained growth.

Our Process

  • 01Digital Overhaul. We implemented a multi-channel digital strategy by listing Bhagirath Homestays across leading Online Travel Agencies (OTAs).
  • 02Data Analytics. By integrating analytics tools, we provided critical insights into consumer behavior and booking trends.
  • 03Revenue Growth. Our approach led to a 30+ increase in bookings and ₹55K+ in revenue, with an Average Daily Rate (ADR) of ₹1,502.36 over a 7-month period.

The Result

30+

Room nights booked across leading Online Travel Agencies over seven months.

₹55K+

Consolidated room revenue generated through strategic digital positioning.

₹1502

Average Daily Rate (ADR) of ₹1,502.36 achieved across the engagement.

100%

Of reservations originated from domestic, mobile-first travelers.

The Result

  • 01100% of reservations originated from domestic travelers.
  • 02Strong mobile commerce trend, with most searches conducted on smartphones by couples seeking quick getaways.
  • 03Ensured guaranteed, upfront revenue through strategic digital positioning.

Client Impact

  • 01The homestay pivoted from generating negligible income to securing dozens of room nights and tens of thousands of rupees in consolidated revenue.
  • 02Equipped with vital tools to continuously target their ideal demographic: domestic, mobile-first couples seeking brief, relaxing retreats in Mirik.

Why Studio 1947?

At Studio 1947, we excel at driving business growth through data-driven digital strategies. Our work with Bhagirath Homestays demonstrates our ability to transform stagnant businesses into thriving, highly visible hospitality ventures.
